entities.name: Combined Attach Procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by a UE in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2 to attach for both EPS and non-EPS services, or both EPS services and SMS only. Also used when UE is already IMSI attached for non-EPS services and attaches for EPS services.

entities.name: EPS Attach Type IE
entities.description: Information element that indicates the type of attach procedure. For combined attach, it carries the value 'combined EPS/IMSI attach'.

entities.name: Combined EPS/IMSI Attach Indication
entities.description: Condition where the UE indicates 'combined EPS/IMSI attach' in the EPS attach type IE when initiating a combined attach procedure.

entities.name: EPS Attach Procedure
entities.description: Base attach procedure for EPS services described in clause 5.5.1.2, which the combined attach procedure follows with exceptions.

relations.description: The combined attach procedure includes the EPS attach type IE with specific indication.
The EPS attach type IE is guarded by the condition that it must indicate 'combined EPS/IMSI attach' for combined attach procedure.
The combined attach procedure follows the steps of the EPS attach procedure with exceptions for specific clauses.
